detail.description:
The Simpsons are here! Hit GO! Roll the dice with the Simpsons family and many other beloved Springfielders! Earn MONOPOLY money, interact with your friends, family members and fellow Tycoons from around the world as you explore the expanding universe of MONOPOLY GO - now featuring Springfield's finest, including the Simpson family (Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie), Mr. Burns, Krusty, and many more! It’s the new way to play - board flipping cleanup not required!
